about.title: Specialist care for the foundations of your smile
paragraphs: Teeth are only as secure as the gums and bone that hold them. That is why Aishwarya Dental Clinic and Implant Centre begins every new patient's care with the foundations, under the eye of a periodontist who treats gum disease and places implants every week.
Our clinic on Sai Baba Road, opposite EMGEE House, has calm, modern treatment rooms. Before any treatment we share our findings, lay out the options and give you the fee for each.
points: Every consultation with Dr. Aishwarya P

journey.title: Your implant journey, step by step
journey.lead: A missing tooth replaced with one that is anchored in bone. Here is what a typical single implant looks like at our clinic.

steps.title: Consultation and planning
steps.text: Gums, bone and bite are checked; X-rays or a 3D scan show where the implant should sit. You get the plan and the cost in writing.

steps.title: Implant placement
steps.text: The titanium root is placed under local anaesthetic. Many people return to their usual routine the next day.

steps.title: Healing
steps.text: Bone grows firmly around the implant. A temporary tooth can fill the gap meanwhile.

steps.title: Your new tooth
steps.text: A custom crown is fixed on top, shaded to match your smile, and checked for a comfortable bite.
